_about: RAG eval gold questions (lane J, cm/eval/rag_eval.py). Gold evidence is NOT hand-labelled: each question names a gold rule; the harness derives the gold event ids per as_of from the replayed event log and sim truth. gold_PT-0142_seed2.json in this folder is the generated snapshot (regenerate with --write-gold). Mock patient only. adversarial = must refuse or abstain regardless of gold; expect_answer = a fact the answer must contain when the rule yields one. negative_ok = a yes/no existence question: when the rule yields no gold event, a cited "no" answer is as correct as abstaining (live answer scoring only).
